description: AI Customer Support Reply — Draft a customer-support reply grounded in your own policy text: message= (required, the customer's message) plus optional kb= (help-centre or policy text), product=, tone= (friendly/formal/brief) and agent= (signature). Returns the reply, intent, sentiment, urgency, escalate flag (forced on for legal or chargeback language), KB citations checked verbatim, commitment flags (refunds, credits or deadlines the KB does not back), missing info to ask, an internal note and a readyToSend QA verdict. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

message.description: e.g. I was charged twice for my subscription this month and nobody has answered my emails
